quotes.text: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.
Productivity growth is strong, and capital investment is robust.

The Federal Open Market Committee approved the following statement for release by a 12 – 0 vote:

summary: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.
The Committee is continuing its policy of maintaining ample reserves in the banking system.
The Committee states that economic activity is expanding at a solid pace, domestic spending has been resilient, productivity growth is strong, and capital investment is robust.
The Committee states that job gains have kept pace with the workforce, the unemployment rate has changed little, and inflation remains elevated.
The Committee states that today's policy action will support a timelier return to its 2 percent goal and that it will deliver price stability.
The statement was approved by a 12 – 0 vote.
